Identifier-first / score floor

There is no password field anywhere on this page. That is what makes the username score floor apply — with a password present its mere presence is the evidence, and the floor is deliberately skipped.

1. Identifier-first login step

Expect: the key icon IS present.

Scores above the floor on name="username".

2. Search box

Expect: NO icon.

A bare text input with no username signal. Before the floor was added, this got an icon — which would have meant a key glyph in every search box on the web.

3. Comment field

Expect: NO icon.

4. Known limitation — placeholder-only login

Expect: NO icon (recorded limitation, not a bug to file).

Scoring reads autocomplete, type, name and id — never placeholder, aria-label or a <label>. A real login field whose only hint is its placeholder therefore falls below the floor and gets no icon. It under-attaches rather than mis-filling, which is the safe direction.
